name: GALVI
families: Shoe brakes, calipers, thrusters, hydraulics, rotating parts and buffers.
analysis: The supplied catalogue forms the initial family map. The live site adds accessible catalogues, but authenticated CAD and unavailable links remain gaps. Compare interface families and actuation options without assuming interchangeability.
identity: NEWCOMEN / GALVI; company identity recorded in the supplied catalogue.

name: Dellner Bubenzer
families: Disc and drum brakes, hydraulics, couplings, monitoring and storm systems.
analysis: Use this range to benchmark system breadth and monitoring integration. CMB-3 provides a concrete fieldbus-monitoring reference; telemetry alone is not a unique proposition.
identity: DELLNER BUBENZER is the current source brand; historical PINTSCH BUBENZER references should retain their original names.

name: SIBRE
families: Drum and disc brakes, rail brakes, buffers, hydraulics and monitoring.
analysis: The download centre provides many dimensioned technical sheets. Keep model suffixes, air gaps and release-pressure conditions attached to each extracted value.
identity: Siegerland-Bremsen GmbH, identified on the technical sheets.

name: Stromag
families: Industrial service and emergency brakes, hydraulic/electromagnetic variants and monitoring.
analysis: The 200-page SIME industrial braking catalogue is a substantial reference despite direct product-page restrictions. Family overview maxima must not be assigned to every model.
identity: Stromag / SIME product identity; official literature links to Regal Rexnord.

name: Twiflex
families: Direct-acting and spring-applied disc calipers, couplings, hydraulics and locking systems.
analysis: The industrial disc-brake catalogue supports comparisons of actuation and force versus pressure. Check diagrams visually: at least one unit conversion is inconsistent in the source.
identity: Twiflex official catalogue identifies Regal Rexnord; historical Altra labels remain in legacy documents.

name: Svendborg Brakes
families: Hydraulic brakes, HPUs, controlled braking, friction parts, connectivity and storm systems.
analysis: This is a useful system-level benchmark for conveyors and heavy industry. Published controls and connectivity mean our advantage must be demonstrated through usability, service and measured outcomes.
identity: Official catalogue identifies Svendborg Brakes as a Regal Rexnord brand.

name: Mondel
families: 200S and 300M shoe brakes, brake wheels, controllers and service accessories.
analysis: Useful for AISE/AIST-oriented industrial and mill-duty research. Imperial dimensions and accessory tables need explicit units; some regional web routes are unavailable.
identity: Mondel is presented within Magnetek products on Columbus McKinnon official sources.

name: EMG
families: ELDRO and ELHY electrohydraulic thrusters, variants and brake controls.
analysis: Benchmark actuation performance, serviceability and factory testing. The vendor is also a potential buy-versus-build reference for early prototypes; family-level ratings need configuration confirmation.
identity: EMG Automation GmbH on the elexis group official domain.
